_comment: Route gw telemetry directly to your own Dash0 tenant (no Collector)
_description: Overrides the maintainer's built-in endpoint so gw sends to your Dash0 instead. Auth token must NOT be committed here — supply via .gw/config.local.json (gitignored, see config.local.telemetry.json) or OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_HEADERS. NOTE: 'enabled' here has no effect — opt-in is per-machine: run 'gw telemetry on' or set GW_TELEMETRY=1.
_usage: Set endpoint to your Dash0 region ingress. Add auth headers via config.local.json or env. Each user who wants to send telemetry runs 'gw telemetry on' on their own machine.
